title: Carney Calls for E.U.-Canada Pact Amid ‘Ferocious Storm’
summary_full: Prime Minister Mark Carney told European lawmakers that an alliance would help to secure sovereignty and independence for his country. The moves come amid a historic low for U.S. ties with Canada.
